channel.title: Observability (OpenTelemetry) :: Juice's documentation
channel.description: Overview Juice records distributed traces and framework metrics with the standard .NET APIs (System.Diagnostics.ActivitySource and Meter). The core packages do not reference OpenTelemetry: the application host decides whether to collect them, which exporters to use (OTLP, Jaeger, Azure Monitor…) and how to sample. One request produces one connected trace, across processes: TraceId = 4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736 POST /orders (ASP.NET Core server span, tagged with the Juice context) └─ mediator PlaceOrder Juice.OpenTelemetry └─ create OrderPlaced outbox save: the context is stored with the message ├─ deliver rabbitmq one per delivery attempt, possibly hours later │ └─ send orders RabbitMQ / NATS producer └─ process orders-queue consumer, in another service └─ handle OrderPlacedHandler The trace context travels in the standard W3C traceparent / tracestate message headers. It is separate from the MessageContext: x-correlation-id and x-causation-id keep their meaning and are copied onto the spans as tags.
